Fully-taxable equivalent (FTE) net interest income for the third quarter increased $18 million, or 1%, from the prior quarter, driven by a 4 basis point increase in the net interest margin (NIM). The increase in NIM reflected higher earning-asset yields, primarily from reinvestment into higher yielding investment securities, and a decrease in average total borrowings, partially offset by higher deposit costs. • Average earning assets decreased $3.3 billion, or 1% , primarily due to a $2.7 billion, or 16%, decrease in interest-earning deposits with banks and a $806 million decrease in average loans and leases. • The yield on total investment and other securities increased quarter-over-quarter. • Average interest-bearing liabilities decreased $3.3 billion , or 2% , primarily due to a $3.6 billion, or 16%, decrease in average total borrowings, partially offset by a $267 million increase in interest-bearing deposits. • The average cost of total deposits increased 2 basis points quarter-over-quarter. Fully-taxable equivalent (FTE) net interest income for the third quarter increased $567 million, or 37%, from the year-ago quarter, driven by higher average earning assets and an increase in NIM, partially offset by higher interest-bearing liabilities. reference.summary: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated operates as the bank holding company for The Huntington National Bank that provides commercial, consumer, and mortgage banking services. It offers financial products and services to consumer and business customers, including deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, dealer financing, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services.
